ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我没说

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_030
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_031
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_033
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_034
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_035
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_036
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_037
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_038
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_039
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_041
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_042
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_043
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_044
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_045
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_046
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你叫什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_047
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_048
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_049
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_050
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_051
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_052
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_053
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_054
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_055
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_056
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_057
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_058
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_059
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_060
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_061
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_062
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_063
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_064
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_065
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_066
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_067
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_068
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_069
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_070
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_071
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_072
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_073
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_074
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_075
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_077
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_078
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_079
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_080
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_081
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_082
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 灯！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_083
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_084
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_085
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_086
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_087
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_088
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_089
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_090
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_091
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_092
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_093
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_094
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_095
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_096
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_097
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_098
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_099
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_100
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_101
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_103
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_104
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_105
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_106
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_107
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_108
ui_voice_tap#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_109
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_110
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_111
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_112
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_113
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_114
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_115
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_118
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_120
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……和那没有关系

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_121
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_122
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_123
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_124
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_125
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_126
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_127
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_128
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_129
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_130
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_131
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……是什么时候？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_132
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_134
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_142
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_143
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_144
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_145
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 命运……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_146
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_147
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_148
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_150
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_151
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_152
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_153
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_155
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_156
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_157
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_159
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_160
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_161
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_163
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不必了，没关系

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_164
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ——祝你幸福

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_000
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_001
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_002
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_003
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……我没说

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_005
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_006
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_007
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_009
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_010
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_011
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_013
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_014
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_015
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_016
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_017
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_018
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_019
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_020
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_021
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_022
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_023
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_024
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_026
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_027
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_029
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_030
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_031
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_033
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_034
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_035
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_036
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_037
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_038
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_039
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_041
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_042
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_043
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_044
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_045
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_046
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 你叫什么？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_047
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_048
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_049
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_050
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_051
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_052
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_053
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_054
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_055
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_056
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_057
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_058
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_059
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_060
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_061
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_062
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_063
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_064
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_065
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_066
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_067
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_068
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_069
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_070
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_071
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_072
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_073
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_074
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_075
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_077
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_078
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_079
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_080
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_081
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_082
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 灯！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_083
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_084
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_085
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_086
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_087
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_088
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_089
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_090
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_091
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_092
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_093
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_094
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_095
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_096
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_097
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_098
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_099
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_100
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_101
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_103
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_104
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_105
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_106
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_107
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_108
heart_voice_caption#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_109
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_110
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_111
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_112
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_113
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_114
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_115
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_118
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_120
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……和那没有关系

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_121
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_122
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_123
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_124
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_125
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_126
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_127
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_128
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_129
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_130
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_131
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……是什么时候？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_132
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_134
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_142
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_143
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_144
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_145
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 命运……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_146
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_147
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_148
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_150
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_151
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_152
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_153
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_155
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_156
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_157
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_159
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_160
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_161
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_163
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 不必了，没关系

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_164
heart_voice_caption#2.text: ——祝你幸福

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_002
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……我没说

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_021
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_022
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_023
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_024
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_026
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_027
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_029
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_030
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_031
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_033
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_034
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_035
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_036
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_037
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_038
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_039
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_041
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_042
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_043
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_044
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_045
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_046
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 你叫什么？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_047
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_048
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_049
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_050
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_051
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_052
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_053
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_054
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_055
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_056
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_057
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_058
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_059
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_060
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_061
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_062
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_063
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_064
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_065
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_066
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_067
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_068
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_069
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_070
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_071
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_072
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_073
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_074
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_075
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_077
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_078
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_079
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_080
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_081
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_082
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 灯！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_083
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_084
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_085
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_086
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_087
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_088
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_089
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_090
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_091
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_092
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_093
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_094
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_095
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_096
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_097
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_098
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_099
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_100
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_101
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_103
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_104
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_105
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_106
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_107
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_108
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_109
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_110
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_111
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_112
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_113
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_114
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_115
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_118
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_120
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……和那没有关系

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_121
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_122
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_123
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_124
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_125
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_126
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_127
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_128
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_129
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_130
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_131
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……是什么时候？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_132
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_134
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_142
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_143
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_144
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_145
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 命运……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_146
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_147
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_148
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_150
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_151
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_152
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_153
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_155
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_156
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_157
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_159
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_160
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_161
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_163
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不必了，没关系

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_164
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: ——祝你幸福

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_002
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……我没说

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_021
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_022
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_023
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_024
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_026
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_027
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_029
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_030
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_031
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_033
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_034
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_035
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_036
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_037
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_038
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_039
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_041
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_042
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_043
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_044
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_045
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_046
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 你叫什么？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_047
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_048
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_049
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_050
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_051
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_052
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_053
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_054
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_055
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_056
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_057
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_058
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_059
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_060
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_061
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_062
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_063
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_064
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_065
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_066
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_067
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_068
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_069
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_070
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_071
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_072
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_073
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_074
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_075
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_077
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_078
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_079
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_080
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_081
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_082
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 灯！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_083
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_084
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_085
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_086
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_087
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_088
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_089
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_090
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_091
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_092
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_093
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_094
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_095
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_096
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_097
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_098
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_099
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_100
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_101
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_103
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_104
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_105
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_106
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_107
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_108
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_109
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_110
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_111
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_112
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_113
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_114
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_115
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_118
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_120
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……和那没有关系

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_121
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_122
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_123
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_124
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_125
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_126
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_127
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_128
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_129
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_130
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_131
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……是什么时候？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_132
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_134
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_142
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_143
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_144
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_145
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 命运……

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_146
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_147
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_148
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_150
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_151
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_152
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_153
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_155
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_156
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_157
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_159
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_160
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_161
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_163
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 不必了，没关系

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_164
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: ——祝你幸福

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……我没说

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_029
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_030
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_031
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_033
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_034
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_035
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_036
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_037
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_038
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_039
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_041
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_042
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_043
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_044
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_045
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_046
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 你叫什么？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_047
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_048
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_049
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_050
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_051
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_052
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_053
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_054
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_055
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_056
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_057
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_058
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_059
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_060
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_061
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_062
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_063
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_064
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_065
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_066
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_067
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_068
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_069
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_070
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_071
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_072
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_073
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_074
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_075
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_077
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_078
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_079
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_080
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_081
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_082
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 灯！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_083
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_084
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_085
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_086
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_087
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_088
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_089
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_090
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_091
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_092
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_093
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_094
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_095
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_096
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_097
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_098
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_099
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_100
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_101
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_103
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_104
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_105
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_106
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_107
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_108
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_109
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_110
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_111
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_112
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_113
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_114
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_115
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_118
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_120
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……和那没有关系

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_121
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_122
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_123
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_124
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_125
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_126
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_127
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_128
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_129
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_130
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_131
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……是什么时候？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_132
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_134
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_142
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_143
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_144
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_145
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 命运……

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_146
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_147
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_148
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_150
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_151
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_152
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_153
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_155
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_156
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_157
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_159
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_160
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_161
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_163
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: 不必了，没关系

heart_speech_1_1_0#2.name: voice_164
heart_speech_1_1_0#2.text: ——祝你幸福

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我没说

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_029
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_030
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_031
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_033
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_034
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_035
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_036
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_037
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_038
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_039
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_041
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_042
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_043
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_044
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_045
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_046
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 你叫什么？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_047
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_048
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_049
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_050
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_051
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_052
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_053
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_054
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_055
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_056
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_057
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_058
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_059
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_060
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_061
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_062
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_063
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_064
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_065
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_066
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_067
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_068
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_069
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_070
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_071
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_072
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_073
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_074
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_075
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_077
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_078
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_079
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_080
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_081
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_082
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 灯！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_083
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_084
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_085
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_086
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_087
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_088
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_089
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_090
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_091
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_092
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_093
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_094
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_095
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_096
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_097
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_098
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_099
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_100
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_101
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_103
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_104
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_105
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_106
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_107
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_108
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_109
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_110
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_111
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_112
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_113
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_114
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_115
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_118
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_120
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……和那没有关系

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_121
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_122
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_123
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_124
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_125
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_126
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_127
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_128
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_129
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_130
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_131
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……是什么时候？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_132
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_134
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_142
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_143
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_144
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_145
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 命运……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_146
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_147
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_148
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_150
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_151
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_152
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_153
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_155
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_156
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_157
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_159
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_160
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_161
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_163
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 不必了，没关系

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_164
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: ——祝你幸福
